LESSON: FAMILY RELATIONSHIPS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: CHRISTIAN LIVING TODAY
Topic 6.1: Family Relationships
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Family Relationships, part of CHRISTIAN LIVING TODAY in Grade 8 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How do you relate with your family members?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
